title: Lemma 10.7: locality and strict Henselianity for a local pushout
statement_scope: Suppose given a pushout diagram of connective E∞-rings with maps among local (strictly Henselian) E∞-rings A, B and A, where π0A→π0A is surjective and the maps φ and ψ are local. Then: (1) B is local (respectively strictly Henselian); (2) for any local E∞-ring R, a map ε:B→R is local if and only if the composites ε∘φ′ and ε∘ψ′ are local; in particular φ′ and ψ′ are local. Complete statement and proof retained as printed.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the lemma proves locality of the pushout B by producing a nonzero map to κ_A⊗κ_B and transferring locality across the π0-surjection, then reduces condition (2) to Lemma 10.6 (statement and proof, physical pages 53-54). This is a non-routine technical step but auxiliary to Proposition 10.4.
